confirmed.context: An unmasked man at the checkout counter directed racial slurs and taunts at another customer, later identified as Barry Allen, and goaded him to fight.
confirmed.sequence: Allen, who appeared to want only to pay for his tallboy and leave, struck the man with the can and continued the altercation on the ground.
confirmed.outcome: Video exceeded 5 million views and became the source meme ("Tea-KO"). This is the registry's index case.

confirmed.weapon_form: 24 oz can, struck to the face
confirmed.context: A domestic dispute; the victim reported the incident to an officer stationed nearby.

confirmed.context: The suspect made threatening calls to a former boss before arriving at the scene.
confirmed.charge_description: Aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, without intent to kill
confirmed.why_provisional: Reporting does not specify which item the charge treats as the deadly weapon. The pipe is the likelier candidate; the can rides along on reputation.
